question: How do you prefer spending your ideal Friday evening after classes?
subtitle: Think about where your energy naturally flows when you're off the clock.

options.text: Building a side project, tinkering with code, or exploring new AI tools.
Jamming with friends, producing beats, or discovering underground artists.
Playing football, shooting hoops on the court, or hitting the gym.
Reading thought-provoking books, journaling, or debating current affairs.
Practicing choreography, rehearsing routines, or dancing in the studio.
Staging theatrical skits, sketching art, or organizing vibrant celebrations.

question: What kind of challenge makes you lose track of time?
subtitle: Pick the problem that excites your mind the most.

options.text: Hunting down tricky software bugs or designing system architectures.
Writing an essay with razor-sharp prose or presenting a winning debate argument.
Perfecting complex syncopated footwork and synchronizing with a crew.
Pushing physical limits during high-stakes matches or intense drills.
Arranging multi-part vocal harmonies or dialing in audio acoustics.
Designing expressive stage backdrops, storytelling sets, and heritage showcases.

question: Which campus event would you be first in line to attend?
subtitle: Select the atmosphere where you feel completely at home.

options.text: An overnight 36-hour hackathon or developer demo day.
An electric inter-college championship match under stadium floodlights.
An energetic live battle-of-the-bands gig on the campus lawn.
A pulse-pounding street dance battle or hip-hop showcase.
A fiery parliamentary debate tournament or spoken-word poetry open mic.
An annual cultural gala with theatrical drama, folk exhibitions, and design.

question: In a club project, where do your talents shine brightest?
subtitle: Your natural role within a collaborative group.

options.text: The Engineer: Solving logic puzzles, writing clean APIs, and automation.
The Wordsmith: Editorial direction, speechwriting, and persuasive communication.
The Strategist & Athlete: Tactical plays, conditioning, and team grit.
The Soundcrafter: Composing melodies, orchestrating sound, and rhythm.
The Choreographer: Creating visual movement, body dynamics, and stage sync.
The Creative Producer: Curating aesthetics, drama direction, and festival flair.

question: If you had 10,000 hours to master one craft, what would it be?
subtitle: Imagine your ultimate passion at elite proficiency.

options.text: Inventing revolutionary software or hardware that changes everyday lives.
Moving with breathtaking grace, power, and rhythm across world stages.
Dominating athletic tournaments with elite physical fitness and clutch plays.
Publishing bestselling books or commanding international debate podiums.
Mastering instruments, acoustic recording, and headlining concerts.
Directing monumental cultural productions, theatre, and arts movements.

question: Which of these quotes resonates with your inner drive?
subtitle: Words to live by for your campus journey.

options.text: "Talk is cheap. Show me the code and solve real problems."
"Where words fail, music speaks and connects human spirits."
"Discipline equals freedom. Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard."
"The pen is mightier than the sword — ideas have the power to reshape the world."
"To dance is to be out of yourself. Larger, more beautiful, more powerful."
"Art and heritage are the heartbeat of civilization; they bring people together."

question: What legacy do you want to create before you graduate?
subtitle: The lasting impression you want to make on college history.

options.text: Launching innovative apps, open-source projects, and mentoring junior coders.
Bringing home championship trophies and building a relentless team spirit.
Creating legendary campus festival tracks and memorable live concerts.
Putting together unforgettable crew choreography that earns standing ovations.
Leading editorial magazines, winning oratory trophies, and elevating campus discourse.
Elevating campus festivals, dramatic theatre, and inclusive cultural celebrations.
